notes.title: Roman Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have just released an exciting major update, here is a summary of the changes:

Revised Culture Mechanics and Unique Civilization Research Trees:
One of the biggest changes involves the culture mechanic. Culture is no longer a victory condition, but now plays a crucial role in unlocking new Tier 2 and Tier 3 buildings. 
By researching different technologies in the university, you will gain access to the tech tree, unlocking buildings, units, and upgrades. These advancements will play a crucial role in developing your island, expanding your empire, and gaining an edge over your opponents.

Each civilization now has its own specific research tree, allowing you to explore different paths of development and advancement. Expand your empire by unlocking new buildings, recruiting powerful units, and improving your strategic skills.

This update adds even more strategic depth and variety to the gameplay experience. Explore the strengths and weaknesses of each civilization, and forge your own path to victory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885942/adf109c18a13cc7fdc576714c94448071237ace0.png

Civilization Unlock System and Roman Empire: 
Introducing the Civilization Unlock System! Every day you can win 6 golds by winning a quick match and use this new currency to unlock civilizations. 
These include the mighty Roman Empire. Acquire it through in-game accumulation or purchase it directly from Steam. Additionally, during the Roman Civilization launch event, daily bonus rewards will be multiplied to accelerate your progress.  

To celebrate the Roman civilization the daily reward is up to 12 gold per day until the end of July.

Water building:
We have introduced new buildings to place in water. You can now build fishing ships that provide a steady source of food without taking up space on your island, ensuring the prosperity of your kingdom. In addition, a new building called a lighthouse will increase the food yield of your fishing ships.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885942/4f50cd6e8143618ffa42d39f7556a1c37627e872.png

Island Expansion:
Shape your kingdom's destiny with a new special building that allows you to expand your island. Strategically plan and build structures to gain a stronger foothold against your enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885942/f711239a4a560159f308f5b85ee163db3708d441.png

Disaster Rebalance:
We heard your feedback! To provide a more balanced experience, we have reduced the impact of three major disasters: Disease, Revolt, and Pirates. They now have 50% of their original effect, giving you more room to recover and strategize effectively.

We hope this new strategic dimension will add excitement and variety to your Dice Kingdoms sessions.
Thank you for your valuable feedback that helped us make these improvements.

Regards, 
The Dice Kingdoms Team

notes.title: Dice Kingdoms' Release Date & Suggestions!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We only have a few days left of beta access and I hope you have enjoyed playing Dice Kingdoms. We would like to thank everyone who gave us feedback and suggestions, some of which we have already implemented and others we have started to work on.

In addition, we would like to express our appreciation for the support we have received from content creators such as Dizoff, whose coverage has helped us reach a wider audience 

In order to keep track of all the suggestions we've received, we're going to create an article for each suggestion on our Discord. This will allow us to have a group discussion about each suggestion.

We have also estimated the time it will take to fix the minor bugs and make other improvements to ensure the best possible experience. We are pleased to announce that the game will be released in Early Access on Steam on April 3, 2023.

Thank you for your continued support and participation in the beta test. We appreciate your valuable feedback and look forward to continuing to work together to make Dice Kingdoms the best it can be.

notes.title: Open Beta lauch and Army Update
notes.notes:
Armies are now more powerful!

We're pleased to announce a new update for Dice Kingdoms that will enhance your gaming experience! Here's what's new:


 Army is now twice as strong
 Villagers now give 2 resources to the attacker when they are defeated in battle.
 The cost of building barracks has been increased.
 The cost of building a dock has been increased.


But that's not all! We're also launching the Dice Kingdoms beta, which will run from the 24th of February until the 5th of March. To join the beta, please sign up on our official Discord server.

Get ready to lead your armies to victory with the new and improved Dice Kingdoms update.

We hope these changes will make for a more dynamic and challenging gameplay experience. As always, we welcome your feedback and suggestions for future updates. 

Happy conquering!
